%% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
%% TH Köln thesis -- preamble (loaded via include-in-header)
%% Do not edit this file in your thesis repository; put your own macros into
%% tex/macros.tex instead. This file is replaced by `quarto update extension`.
%% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

%=== Fonts / typography ======================================================
\usepackage{iftex}
\ifLuaTeX
  \usepackage{selnolig}% correct ligature suppression
\fi
\usepackage{csquotes}
\usepackage{microtype}

%=== Header and footer (KOMA-Script) =========================================
\usepackage{scrlayer-scrpage}
\clearpairofpagestyles
\ohead{\headmark}
\ofoot*{\pagemark}

%=== TH Köln colours ==========================================================
\definecolor{THRed}{RGB}{207,24,32}
\definecolor{THOrange}{RGB}{236,101,37}
\definecolor{THPurple}{RGB}{175,54,140}

%=== Graphics generated in the source (TikZ / pgfplots) ======================
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}

%=== Pseudocode for algorithms (`::: {#alg-...}` with \begin{algorithmic}) =====
\usepackage{algpseudocodex}
% Quarto sets algorithms in italics; procedure names are small caps, which have
% no italic shape in Latin Modern -- keep them upright.
\renewcommand*{\textproc}[1]{\textup{\textsc{#1}}}

%=== Maths: mathtools is loaded in partials/doc-class.tex (before unicode-math)

%=== Code blocks: wrap long lines instead of running into the margin ==========
%    (fvextra itself is loaded in partials/doc-class.tex, before csquotes)
\DefineVerbatimEnvironment{Highlighting}{Verbatim}{breaklines,commandchars=\\\{\}}
\RecustomVerbatimEnvironment{verbatim}{Verbatim}{breaklines}

%=== Bibliography: break long URLs, ragged right (no stretched lines) =========
\setcounter{biburllcpenalty}{7000}
\setcounter{biburlucpenalty}{8000}
\appto{\bibsetup}{\raggedright}

%=== Typographic details ======================================================
\frenchspacing
\setcounter{tocdepth}{\subsectiontocdepth}
% room for Roman page numbers such as VIII in the table of contents
\DeclareTOCStyleEntries[pagenumberwidth=2.4em]{tocline}{chapter,section,subsection,figure,table}
